# BARL: Broadcast Assistant for Rocket League

> BARL is a free downloadable Rocket League broadcasting overlay. It provides an automated series score tracker, real-time team boost meters, and customizable team names and logos. Works while spectating, playing yourself, or watching replays. Download is available via the BARL Discord server.

## Product

- [BARL Product Page](https://lndrlndr.github.io/BARL/): Detailed feature list with video demonstrations and download link
- [BARL in French](https://lndrlndr.github.io/BARL/index_fr.html): French language version of the BARL product page
- [Download BARL](https://lndrlndr.github.io/BARL_App/): Direct download page for the latest BARL installer

## Features

- Automated series score tracker (works for any best-of format)
- Real-time team boost meters and individual player boost boxes
- Customizable team names and logos via an in-app Control Panel
- Works in spectator mode, while playing, and in replay mode
- Free tier available; premium plan adds community overlay designs and full custom design modification
- Simple installation: launcher download available in Discord, auto-integrates with Rocket League and OBS
